name: Vanquish the Invaders
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 1,050 experience instead of 10,500, 0.1 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young champion. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.

Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!

Do this, and earn a talisman of merit.  Bring me such a talisman, adventurer, and I shall reward you.
narrative.objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
